name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Deliver: Push link coverage toward 100% at +5%/day (the access gate)

name: Reel
text: We should assign a dedicated team member to review and update the link coverage daily, ensuring we meet the +5%/day target. This decision is best because it allows for consistent progress and prompt identification of gaps in coverage, enabling us to adjust our strategy as needed. By doing this, we're accepting the trade-off of dedicating a team member's time and resources to this task, potentially diverting attention from other important tasks. This focus, however, is necessary to push link coverage toward 100% effectively.

name: Scriv
text: Assigning a dedicated reviewer won’t fix the core problem: if the team lacks the authority to enforce link fixes, the reviewer becomes a bottleneck, not a solution. Instead, tie link coverage to the pull request gate—block merges until coverage meets the threshold. That settles it: either the PRs get fixed, or the work stalls, forcing ownership.
